company.description: OKCredit simplifies credit account management for shop owners and their customers. It is a mobile based solution that enables recording of credit/payment transactions digitally all across the country. Gaurav Kumar and Aditya Prasad founded it in April 2017, with its headquarters in Faridabad in India.

insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 33 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 46 (-2).
